legalization.title: Legalization

niw.title: EB-2 National Interest Waiver
niw.description: Employment-based Green Card for professionals with exceptional ability. No job offer is required when benefit to the US national interest is demonstrated.

noOffer.title: No job offer required

family.title: Spouse and children included

selfPetition.description: You are the case holder and remain in charge of your career in the United States.

messageGuide.eb3: Helpful to include: whether you already have a US job offer, type of role (skilled or unskilled), and required education/experience.
messageGuide.o1: Helpful to include: your area of extraordinary talent, awards, US contracts or projects, evidence of recognition in your field.
messageGuide.h1b: Helpful to include: US job offer, role, sponsoring employer, and higher education in the role's field.
messageGuide.l1: Helpful to include: link to a multinational company, role (executive/managerial or specialized knowledge), and tenure.
messageGuide.e2: Helpful to include: planned investment amount, nationality (for a US treaty country), and business plan.
messageGuide.outro: Helpful to include: describe your immigration goal and current situation.

aboutPage.title: We turn talent, purpose, and family into new beginnings.
aboutPage.intro: Akros Immigration Solutions serves highly qualified professionals who want to immigrate. We combine strategy, close support, and a specialized network to guide decisions about career and family integration in the United States.
aboutPage.teamSubtitle: Immigration law, business strategy, and career preparation in one team, so no detail of your project is left without direction.

natalia.name: Natalia Luz
natalia.bio: Attorney graduated from PUC/SP in 2010, with over 14 years of experience in civil law and intellectual property. In 2020 she received her own Green Card based on exceptional ability. That journey led her to open the same path for other Brazilian professionals.

denise.name: Dra. Denise Sarchiapone
denise.bio: US-licensed attorney based in the Washington DC area, with an MBA in International Business and 18 years living in the country. She confirms the legal strategy of every case before the process formally begins.

bruno.name: Bruno Luz
bruno.bio: Economist from Mackenzie University, with over 15 years in banking and business consulting. Since 2020 he has built more than 250 business plans for foreign investors in the United States.

elem.name: Elem Tluczek
elem.bio: HR professional with 10 years of experience in employee lifecycle, diversity programs, and Brazilian and US employment compliance. She prepares clients for the American job market.

professionalism.title: Professionalism
professionalism.description: Technical rigor and attention to detail in every document and petition.

closeness.title: Close support

visasPage.title: Your project deserves the right visa.
visasPage.subtitle: Explore the most sought-after categories to live, work, invest, or study in the United States. Eligibility depends on your background and is assessed individually.

eb1.name: EB-1
eb1.description: Extraordinary ability in science, arts, education, business, or athletics.

eb2.name: EB-2
eb2.description: Professionals with advanced degrees or exceptional ability. Requires a job offer.

eb2niw.name: EB-2 NIW
eb2niw.description: Green Card with no job offer required, when there's benefit to the US national interest.

eb3.name: EB-3
eb3.description: Professionals, skilled and unskilled workers with a job offer.

eb4.name: EB-4
eb4.description: Special immigrant: religious workers, international organization employees, and others.

f1.name: F-1
f1.description: Status change from tourist to student in the US.

l1.name: L-1
l1.description: Transfer of employees from multinational companies to US branches.

e2.name: E-2
e2.description: Investor visa to develop and direct business operations in the US.

p1.name: P-1
p1.description: Athletes, artists, and entertainment teams for specific competitions or events.

r.name: R
r.description: Ministers and other religious members for work in a religious capacity.

h1b.name: H-1B
h1b.description: Specialty occupations for professionals with advanced degrees or specific skills.

h2b.name: H-2B
h2b.description: Temporary workers for non-agricultural labor needs.

methodologyPage.title: Strategy for the process. Care for the move.
methodologyPage.subtitle: Every client is unique. That is why we guide your journey through seven clear steps, with technical care and close support from the first assessment to preparation for your new life.
methodologyPage.journeyNote: You understand where you are, what comes next, and who is responsible for each stage. No guesswork, no being left in the dark.
methodologyPage.imageAlt: Personalized planning for a new life in the United States

1.title: Profile and goals analysis
1.description: We start by understanding your background, your present moment, and the future you want to build in the United States.

2.title: Specialist consultation
2.description: We thoroughly assess your options for immigration processes or non-immigrant visas and present the investment required.

3.title: Partner attorney consultation
3.description: Our partner attorney reviews your information and confirms the legal strategy best suited to your case.

4.title: Contract and initial payment
4.description: With the strategy defined, we formalize the engagement and align the best way to start your journey.

5.title: Document organization
5.description: With a Case Manager’s support, we organize documents and forms so each piece of information is complete and consistent.

6.title: Approval and USCIS filing
6.description: Your process only moves forward to USCIS after final review and your approval.

7.title: Relocation preparation
7.description: While the decision is pending, you can begin preparing for the move with more clarity and confidence.

servicesPage.title: The process is only the beginning of your new life.
servicesPage.subtitle: Beyond immigration strategy, we bring together services that give shape to your life project and strengthen your professional story in the United States.

immigrationPlan.title: Immigration plan
immigrationPlan.description: Immigration takes courage and planning. We help you understand housing, schools, climate, security, and the business environment of the region you hope to call home.

businessPlan.title: Business plan
businessPlan.description: With specialized partners, we structure a Business Plan with project execution, market analysis, management, and financial projections. It is a key asset for several immigration strategies.

americanResume.title: American-format resume
americanResume.description: We turn your background into a resume that highlights professional growth, essential skills, and achievements that matter for your new plans.

recommendationLetters.title: Recommendation letters
recommendationLetters.description: We support the structure of letters from colleagues, leaders, clients, or respected references to demonstrate your experience and the value of your work.
